name: Recipes
tagline: Save recipes, plan meals and build shopping lists.
description: Recipes saves recipes from any website, then helps you plan the week and build a shopping list. Everyone at home can share the same cookbook. It is built on Mealie, a free and open-source recipe manager.
whatsNew: Installs on your box with saved files, live status and start and stop controls. Finish account setup when you first open the app.
